generations.purpose: Hero image for brand kit — warm connected memory concept
generations.prompt: A warm, human-centered hero image for the Allura memory brand, featuring overlapping translucent blue and orange circles on a soft cream background, suggesting connection and preservation. Geometric shapes with organic warmth, modern technology meets human care. Soft directional lighting, minimal Swiss design influence. No photorealistic people, no text, no 3D effects, no gradients. Clean vector aesthetic.
